extraction_notes: The requested BCX53-16(RANGE:100-250) corresponds to the BCX53-16 rank in the p. 2 Classification of hFE(2) table, which gives a 100-250 range. The PDF identifies the family as BCX51, BCX52, BCX53 PNP transistors and lists BCX53-16 in the marking table on p. 1.
The supplied PDF SHA-256 was verified as 7a4729270f3eed6b8af7a6dea44eccfcb893bfeca33db7c521f472a64d01b4eb.
All electrical-characteristics values are specified at Ta=25 degC unless otherwise specified. Signed negative collector, base, and emitter currents and PNP voltages are retained.

The p. 2 hFE(2)* electrical-characteristics row is the family row at VCE=-2 V and IC=-150 mA. For the exact BCX53-16 target, the p. 2 classification range supplies the target-specific minimum 100 and maximum 250; no typical hFE value was invented.

The p. 2 table publishes one maximum VCE(sat) row at IC=-0.5 A and IB=-50 mA. The adjacent VBE* row is base-emitter voltage at VCE=-2 V and IC=-0.5 A, not VBE(sat), so vbe_sat is null and that row is not relabelled.

Cobo and Cib have no scalar electrical-characteristics table rows in the supplied datasheet. Their scalar values and curve points are approximate direct manual digitizations of the p. 3 log-log typical Cob/Cib plot at the stated reverse biases; they are not guaranteed limits and are not rank-specific.

The p. 3 typical-characteristics curves were read directly at labelled or major-grid positions. No points were interpolated between observations. The static-characteristic plot was not digitized because the multiple IB trace values are not sufficiently reproducible as numeric points from the supplied figure. The IC-VBE and Pc-Ta plots were not included because they are not needed for the schema's BJT curve/spec fields.
The source PDF footer identifies the revision as E,Nov,2015; this is normalized to E, Nov 2015 in datasheet_identity.revision.
